name: Serenza
desc: Pastel houses stacked up a ravine to a tiny harbour, terraced vineyards going back to bramble, and a train that dives in and out of the cliffs.

meter.name: Terraces in use
meter.about: Sixteen terraces climb Serenza's ravine and only two are still tended. Mend a terrace's wall and plant something green on it, a vine pergola, a lemon tree, a young tree, a flower bed or a hedge, and it's back in use, for good. Any terrace counts, request or not.

milestones.title: Green on the hill
milestones.desc: Four terraces in use. Settimio opens the cooperative's tin and counts out thirty coins, twice.

milestones.title: The lizards are back
milestones.desc: Wall lizards bask on the new stones. Settimio gives you the lemon tree's plan and two saplings from his own trees.

milestones.title: Settimio takes his hat off
milestones.desc: Half the hillside is green. Settimio takes his hat off to you, briefly, and hands over three vine saplings and forty coins.

milestones.title: Ready for Easter
milestones.desc: Ten terraces in use: the procession can climb through green all the way up. Tell Marta.

milestones.title: The hillside in green
milestones.desc: Thirteen terraces. The hiking club sends a postcard of the hillside, and the cooperative a hundred coins.

milestones.title: Sixteen of sixteen
milestones.desc: Every terrace in Serenza is in use. A slate plaque with your name goes up by the cellar door, and the cooperative pays a hundred and fifty coins.
